title: Controlled Block Proximal Linearized Method for Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.34390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization without assuming bounded iterates or coercivity of the original objective. We propose the Controlled Block Proximal Linearized (CBPL) method, which incorporates a control potential into block updates while retaining the original objective, variables, and constraints. Under explicit control design conditions and the KL property, the control yields boundedness, finite length, whole-sequence convergence of the original variables, and convergence of objective values. At the limit, one limiting subgradient of the original objective vanishes on all effective comparison directions. We apply CBPL to graph-regularized nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), CP decomposition, and independent-core matrix tri-factorization (NMTF) with $\ell_0$ norm sparsity constraints. translated_title: 面向非凸非光滑优化的受控块近端线性化方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究多块非凸非光滑优化问题，且不假设迭代点有界或原目标函数具有强制性（coercivity）。我们提出了受控块近端线性化方法，该方法在保留原有目标函数、变量和约束的同时，将控制势函数引入到块更新之中。在明确的控制设计条件和Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz（KL）性质下，该控制机制带来迭代点的有界性、有限长度性质、原始变量的全序列收敛以及目标函数值的收敛。在极限点处，原目标函数的一个极限次梯度在所有有效比较方向上为零。我们将CBPL应用于带图正则化的非负矩阵分解（NMF）、CP分解以及带 $\ell_0$ 范数稀疏约束的独立核矩阵三分解（NMTF），刻画了这些问题中保持重构的尺度退化性，并证明了尺度临界性等价于图……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出受控块近端线性化（CBPL）方法，无需假设迭代点有界或目标函数强制性，即可在KL性质下实现多块非凸非光滑优化中原始变量的全序列收敛，并将其成功应用于NMF、CP分解和NMTF等问题，刻画了保持重构的尺度退化性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Controlled Block Proximal Linearized (CBPL) method, which achieves whole-sequence convergence of original variables for multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization without assuming bounded iterates or coercivity, and applies it to graph-regularized NMF, CP decomposition, and NMTF with $\ell_0$ sparsity constraints while characterizing their reconstruction-preserving scale degeneracies.
